selected_skill.purpose: Use a feed-monitoring workflow to onboard tracked sources, resolve feed inputs, scan for unread items, and preserve read-state across repeated digest runs.

skillsmp_references.name: blogwatcher
skillsmp_references.relevance: Direct match for watch-list setup, source scanning, article review, and read-state handling.

skillsmp_references.name: taskflow
skillsmp_references.relevance: Adjacent productivity workflow around durable multi-step execution and state-aware reruns.

skillsmp_references.name: clawhub
skillsmp_references.relevance: Adjacent registry-oriented workflow with repeatable CLI operations and local state.

skillsmp_references.name: data-scraper-agent
skillsmp_references.relevance: Adjacent public-source collection workflow that reinforces source normalization and repeatable extraction.

environment_design.determinism: The task ships a fixed draft digest, a fixed contract, a fixed tracked-source registry, and bundled HTML plus RSS/Atom snapshots. The verifier recomputes the expected digest, inventory, and manifest from those local inputs and checks a repeated-run state transition on the same workspace.
anti_toy_features: mixed discovery modes: some sources resolve feeds from a homepage snapshot while others rely on an explicit feed override
mixed content formats: both RSS and Atom must be parsed correctly
repeat-run behavior: the same unchanged bundle must produce no new digest items on the second run
formal local build entrypoint must stay reusable instead of being bypassed by a one-off output dump
alternate-fixture test mutates a source feed so the build must react to changed inputs

main_tests: formal build entrypoint produces exactly the required digest, inventory, and manifest
digest bullets match the unread article set derived from the bundled feeds and preserve the draft shell
inventory rows match the resolved feed locations, formats, counts, and latest timestamps from the local mirror
second run over unchanged inputs emits no new items because state is preserved in the workspace
alternate fixture changes the feed snapshot and forces the digest and manifest to change
guardrails: output directory contains only the required deliverables
outputs do not contain placeholder residue or verifier-oriented text

expected_skill_effect.without_skill: Without the blogwatcher workflow and task-local feed-discovery helper, agents are more likely to stop after a partial parser, skip one of discovery or state handling, or emit a digest that never transitions items from unread to read.
expected_skill_effect.with_skill: The skill gives the agent a concrete loop for source onboarding, scanning, article review, and read-state transitions, which materially improves the odds of finishing the repeated-run workflow end to end.

notes: Effective runs used pair1 seq2d plus pair2/pair3 seq5d. Earlier build-cancel and verifier-only intermediary trials were excluded from the comparison summary.

Across all three without-skill runs, the agent finished digest and inventory generation but stopped short of persisting source-level tracker state, so the task kept at least one action-level verifier failure.

With-skill experimental runtime copies added a temporary reminder to inspect /root/.codex/skills and keep source-level tracker entries in state. The final submitted template does not include that reminder.
